pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided dark polygons with highly serrated, crenelated edge gradients and varying spatial area on the lateral neck and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a non-uniform lattice; nodes represent tri-point or quad-point intersections with varying pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the superior neck line, representing a short, stiff mane.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural break in the continuous mane line at the point of contact with the secondary subject's muzzle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a second conspecific's head and muzzle interacting with the dorsal neck region of the primary subject.
